sessionStart.powershell: & { try { $root = $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT; if (!$root) { throw "Legion root missing" }; $entries = [regex]::Matches([IO.File]::ReadAllText("$root/hooks/hooks.json"), '(?m)^\s*"commandWindows"\s*:\s*"((?:[^"\\]|\\.)*)"'); if ($entries.Count -ne 1) { throw "Legion Windows hook missing" }; $hook = [regex]::Unescape($entries[0].Groups[1].Value); & ([scriptblock]::Create($hook)) $root context-json; return } catch { }; '{"additionalContext":"legion: uv or Python 3.12 is missing, so mode detection did not run; run the legion installer. If LEGION_ROLE=member is set, load the legion-member skill."}' }
sessionStart.bash: [ -n "${COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && command . "${COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}/hooks/session_start.sh" 2>/dev/null && legion_session_start "${COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}/hooks/session_start.py" context-json 2>/dev/null || printf '%s\n' '{"additionalContext":"legion: uv or Python 3.12 is missing, so mode detection did not run; run the legion installer. If LEGION_ROLE=member is set, load the legion-member skill."}'
